text:
Alex: Heads-up — we need to lock scope/prioritization for Parallel multi-step tool calling. ACME and FinCo escalated: they want both fan-out (multiple tool calls in parallel) and multi-step workflows with ordered fallbacks. Meeting Friday 10am to finalize, but posting a short thread to capture constraints and quick decisions.
Maria: Customer asks summarized: (1) run multiple tool calls concurrently when independent, (2) express dependencies between steps, (3) have per-call and overall timeouts, (4) clear retry semantics and idempotency, (5) predictable cost/latency.
Kevin: From runtime perspective main constraints: GPU/CPU contention if we fan-out to many external tools (HTTP). We need backpressure and a caps on parallelism per request (default max_parallel = 3). Also need correlation IDs for traces.
Priya: Model/LLM-level concerns: parallel calls change token timing and cache usage. We should surface a merge strategy for outputs (e.g., 'first_valid', 'merge', 'ordered_concat') and allow users to provide deterministic reducers.
Rita: UX/SDK: prefer simple ergonomics. Proposed API top-level param: steps: [ {id, tool, run_in_parallel, depends_on, timeout_ms, retry_policy} ] and a simple boolean run_in_parallel at group-level. Keep defaults conservative.
Jon: Ops: rollout must be feature-flagged + beta customers only. Metrics we need: per-step latency, per-step success rate, retries, and cost estimate per request. Also require circuit-breaker when external tool has high error rate.
Maria: Launch criteria proposal: (a) SDK support for steps + structured output, (b) runtime enforces max_parallel and per-call timeouts, (c) E2E test harness (simulated tools) validates correctness for ordering/merge strategies, (d) perf within 1.5x of baseline for common patterns, (e) docs/examples for 3 customer use-cases.
Kevin: Implementation notes: prefer declarative plan execution. Execution engine will schedule independent steps in parallel up to max_parallel. For steps with depends_on, schedule after dependencies complete. Retries: default 2 attempts with exponential backoff and jitter. Make retry opt-out per step.
Alex: API sample (pseudo):
```
POST /v1/chat.completions
{
  'model': 'redwood-chat-1',
  'steps': [
    {'id':'search1', 'tool':'web_search','run_in_parallel':true,'timeout_ms':800},
    {'id':'ner','tool':'entity_extractor','depends_on':['search1'],'timeout_ms':300},
    {'id':'rank','tool':'reranker','depends_on':['ner','search1'],'timeout_ms':400,'merge_strategy':'ordered_concat'}
  ],
  'max_parallel': 3,
  'global_timeout_ms': 3000
}
```
Priya: Important: clarify ordering guarantees. If run_in_parallel true, we cannot promise deterministic ordering unless user indicates a merge strategy. For strict ordering, user must set depends_on chain (sequential). Document that parallel runs are eventually consistent; provide sequence numbers in structured output for consumer-side ordering.
Rita: SDK surfaces: helper builders for common patterns: fanout_then_rerank(), parallel_map(tool, inputs), and step builders with on_retry callbacks. Examples for 'search-then-summarize' and 'multi-tool-factcheck'.
Maria: Prioritization ask: we have limited eng bandwidth. Suggest phases — Phase 1 (MVP): steps array, max_parallel enforcement, per-step timeout, basic retry (1 retry), 'first_valid' and 'ordered_concat' merge strategies, feature flag rollout. Phase 2: advanced retry policies, idempotency tooling, cost-estimator, SDK helpers, canary with ACME and FinCo.
Kevin: Agree. Also add acceptance test: simulated flaky tool that fails 50% of the time; system should respect retry configs and show stable success for 'first_valid' merge in 95% of runs. Include perf test for 95th pct latency.
Jon: Security/compliance: external tool callers must run in customer VPC for Private deployments. Ensure KMS keys used for any payload encryption. Log redaction policy for PII.
Alex: Open design questions to decide before Friday: 1) default max_parallel (3?), 2) default retry count (1 or 2?), 3) allowed merge_strategies list, 4) SDK ergonomics (builders vs raw structs). Please reply with quick votes.
Maria: Vote: max_parallel=3, retry_count=1 (increaseable per step), merge_strategies=['first_valid','merge','ordered_concat'], SDK=builders+raw.
Kevin: Vote: max_parallel=4 (for internal staging), retry_count=2 (safer), merge_strategies as Maria, SDK raw first then add builders.
Priya: Vote: max_parallel=3, retry_count=1, merge_strategies include 'confidence_weighted', SDK builders.
Rita: Vote: max_parallel=3, retry_count=1, SDK builders for ergonomics.
Alex: Tally: tentative default max_parallel=3, retry_count=1, include merge_strategy options 'first_valid','ordered_concat','merge','confidence_weighted' (beta). SDK to include builders and raw structures.
DeployBot: Feature flag created: ff/parallel-steps (enabled for internal + beta). Canary group placeholder: ACME-finco-beta.
Maria: Next steps: write short spec doc (PR to /docs) with API examples, acceptance tests, and rollout plan. Kevin/Rita to own SDK/runtime spike this week. Jon to add observability/flag config. Priya to write model-level notes. I'll consolidate after Friday meeting. :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll put a spike ticket and a perf test ticket.
Rita: I'll prototype UX for step builder.
Alex: Thanks all — keep comments here if you think we missed anything.
